facts.business: Samtex Fashions Limited appears to be a fashion/apparel company that has not undertaken any manufacturing or business activity since 2019, with its plant originally set up at NSEZ, Noida and later shifted.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) Non-recognition of impairment and non-charge of depreciation on Property, Plant and Equipment since no manufacturing activity since 2019; (b) Unconfirmed and long-outstanding trade receivables of Rs 552.93 lacs with no ECL recognized; (c) Non-recognition and remeasurement of employee benefit costs per Ind AS 19. Emphasis of Matter: Corporate guarantee of Rs 807.46 crores for subsidiary SSA International Limited classified as NPA, notice under SARFAESI Act, and wilful defaulter proceedings; consortium bankers filed petition against company and subsidiary.
